old: One scale throughout. The P-100 is already in the Hindenburg's class; the P-1000 is a machine with no built precedent at all; the P-10000 would be nearly twice the Lions Gate Bridge's main span, among the largest objects humans have ever made move. A person is about one pixel tall in this figure. That is the size of the ambition, and it is why the first build is one sealed cell on a bench. The article proves the joints, the film and the seal, and it can be built this year.
